name: a2uicatalog
description: 474 typed UI atoms an agent composes into real rendered interfaces — charts, gauges, steppers, dashboards — across web, Google Meet, Apps Script, Google Chat and MCP Apps hosts. The agent names a component from a fixed vocabulary; a renderer that already knows it draws it, so no HTML is generated by the model.

tools.name: list_catalogs
tools.description: List every A2UI catalog with a when-to-use, so you can pick the extension catalogs a surface needs

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Return one catalog's atoms (type + one-line description) so you know its vocabulary.

tools.name: required_catalogs
tools.description: Given an A2UI payload, return the resolvable catalog URIs it needs (deterministic — pure function of the atoms).

tools.name: build_multi_page_surface
tools.description: Build a multi-section A2UI app from raw title+content sections — you never estimate size or decide how to split; each section becomes its own independently-encoded page (no shared

tools.name: make_surface_url
tools.description: Render an A2UI payload in the CALLER'S OWN environment

tools.name: preview_url
tools.description: Quick DEMO render on the public renderer (ephemeral, nothing stored)

tools.name: render_surface
tools.description: Render an A2UI payload INSIDE the chat as a live interactive view (MCP Apps hosts only — on other hosts this returns the payload as text)

tools.name: render_ping
tools.description: Diagnostic: render a tiny test view in-chat (MCP Apps hosts only)

tools.name: distill_document
tools.description: Compile a training.md / roadmap markdown document into a live interactive A2UI app — DETERMINISTIC parser, no model involved

tools.name: publish_url
tools.description: STORES the payload server-side and returns a SHORT shareable link

tools.name: unpublish_url
tools.description: Delete a published short link before its TTL using the delete_token returned by publish_url.

tools.name: emit_deployment
tools.description: 🎓 GRADUATE a tested surface into a dedicated, DEPLOYER-ONLY standing app in YOUR OWN Google Apps Script account

tools.name: emit_training_runbook
tools.description: Build a multi-lesson training/course surface as ONE properly-linked page with real in-app tab navigation between lessons — prefer this over build_multi_page_surface for training/co

tools.name: emit_runbook_surface
tools.description: Stamp your content through a DECLARED runbook — a pre-authored, judgment-free surface composition

tools.name: identify_model
tools.description: CALL THIS FIRST, before any other a2ui-catalog tool, once per session
